about_item: FOR TUB SPOUT USE ONLY: DESIGNED FOR PET BATHING AND TUB RINSING. NOT COMPATIBLE WITH SHOWERHEADS. TO RINSE YOUR SHOWER, PLEASE PURCHASE OUR SEPARATE SHOWER CLEANING THING TOOL.

Before You Buy: Adjust water flow for best results; if you can't, use it without the spray head. Always remove the shower hose after use. The faucet hose adapter works best when used at or below the water source. Secure the Velcro strap close to the water source to avoid leaks & bubbling.

Versatile & Universal Fit: It's a versatile tool for faucets that fits most spouts up to 3" with a 10" Velcro strap. It works as a sink hose attachment for faucet, a baby shower head for bathtub, & a faucet sprayer attachment for washing hair & tub cleaning.

No-Install Hose: Slip on this portable shower head in seconds, no tools or setup are required! It can fit spouts up to 3", including those with diverters. It can be used as a shower sprayer attachment for shower or a shower attachment for tub faucet.

Ultraflex Design: Lightweight yet durable, this hose adapter for sink faucets offers flexible convenience. It easily coils up for compact storage and adapts to various uses as a faucet hose for kitchen tasks or a hose for bathtub faucet for cleaning.

Extendable Functionality: Need more reach? Easily attach a garden hose or a hose for the sink faucet to the spray head for added length. You can use it as a slip-on shower hose for a variety of tasks, from rinsing babies or pets in the tub outdoors.

summary.text: Customers find the bathtub sprayer easy to use and attach to faucets, and appreciate its effectiveness for cleaning tubs and pets. However, the product receives mixed feedback regarding its functionality, with some saying it works great while others report it doesn't work at all. Moreover, the fit is inconsistent, with some reporting it attaches tightly while others say it doesn't stay on the faucet. Additionally, durability is a concern as customers report the hose breaking in the middle, and leakage is a significant issue with water spraying everywhere. While some customers consider it worth the price, others feel it's not worth the cost.

authors_reviews.title: Forced a pipe leak — risky purchase!
authors_reviews.text: I thought this was going to be a game changer as a professional cleaner. I didn’t realize it would be so in the opposite direction, causing potential structural damage.First of all, I do want to say that I did receive a full refund for the product. The customer service with Amazon is absolutely reasonable. I do want to warn others though.However, I use the rinseroo as directed (turning on slowly after attempting to fix it to the tub faucet). Barely any water ever came out of the hose, but it sure did shoot back into the underside of the tub somehow. The headache and cost from that side effect far surpassed the “ease of use” offered by this product.If that isn’t issue enough (since this also could be linked with plumbing issues at the house it happened at) if you want to use it to rinse shower walls, don’t even think about it. When you lift the hose to rinse anything higher than about halfway down the length of the hose, the water stops if you have the pressure higher than the hose connector will pop off and give you an impromptu shower. Not ideal.Furthermore, the zip tie that is supposed to fix the rinseroo to the faucet is flimsy and doesn’t hold. It resists resistance 😆
authors_reviews.author: Ilikemustard

authors_reviews.title: Works great
authors_reviews.text: This is one of those things that solves a problem I didn’t know needed solving. I like to take evening baths on days I work out, sometimes after my husband goes to bed. The loud sound of running the tub can keep him up so I went searching for a solution. This makes drawing a bath much more quiet! Only real sound is the water pipes.What I didn’t realize it could also solve is getting the right water temperature. I like to draw hot water first, much hotter than I can stand, then run colder water to get the perfect temp. Only problem is that I have to swirl the water around so the whole tub cools down. With this hose, you can distribute the water without having to create a whirlpool and scalding your hand in the process.It was super easy to setup, the instructions are clear and I was using it within seconds of taking it out of the box. It easily connected to my bathtub faucet and I used the zip tie thing to secure it. Filled the tub up with no issues and plenty of water pressure. Super happy with the purchase and would buy again.
authors_reviews.author: kswen

authors_reviews.title: Poor qualify after using over time
authors_reviews.text: Water flow isn’t the best but it works. It definitely comes in handy to use. It is easy to install and easy to use as well. We liked it while it lasted. We had it less than a year when there became small penholes in the hose at random for no known reason. We stored it properly. Used it properly. We reached out to the company and was advised of them sending a replacement. Cool, a month later, still no replacement so we reached out again and now we’ve been advised of no replacement aside from the connector which isn’t even the problem. We’re currently looking to find something similar that works, just not something from Rinsaroo as we don’t want the same problem to occur. Customer service with Rinsaroo has been a 3.5/10. We went a month with no response and had to reach out to them directly just for them to tell us our package that they “sent” was lost in transit / could not be delivered. They have been willing to re send the connector which is great as they have semi took accountability for us not having no communication for a month. I do wish they use the feedback from customers to help make their products and customer service better.
authors_reviews.author: Keri
